channel.title: Cursor Changelog
channel.description: The latest product updates, release notes, and improvements from Cursor.

item.title: Origin App Marketplace
item.description: Origin integrates with over 20 apps for deployments, CI, code review, security, monitoring, and project management, and the marketplace is now open to public submissions.

item.title: Remote control for local agents
item.description: See and reply to the local agents running on your computer from the Cursor iOS app.

item.title: Rollouts and Security Review
item.description: Two bots for the last mile of shipping code: Rollouts watches every change as it deploys, and Security Review reports exploitable bugs on every pull request.
